name: category-product-rows
title: Category product rows
description: Several categories on one page, each with its name, a View all link and a short row of product cards, so the whole catalogue reads at a glance.
docs: Pass categories: each has a name (the heading of its section), an href, an optional description line, total (how many products the category holds in all, the number in 'View all 48') and products in the ProductCard shape. perRow (2 to 6, default 4) says how many cards a row holds on a wide screen and so how many of the products are drawn; a phone always shows two across, and the grid answers to the width of the block itself rather than the screen, so it also works beside a sidebar. A category with fewer products than a row shows what it has, with no placeholders; one with none says so, and a category whose total is 0 has no link. Hairlines divide the sections and every section is a region named by its own heading. The 'View all' link is named for a screen reader as 'View all 48 in Kitchen knives', so six of them are not six of the same. onAddToCart and renderImage go to every card. linkAs renders the links with your router's Link, locale writes the totals and labels holds the fixed words. Apart from the cards it keeps no state, so it renders on the server.
